name: Geometry Shader Instancing
definition: A technique for real-time amplification and instancing of surfels and voxels using the programmable Geometry Shader unit, where the CPU packs point attributes into a buffer and issues a single draw call.
summary: Geometry Shader Instancing is a real-time rendering technique that amplifies point primitives into surfels or voxels and instances them on the GPU using a programmable Geometry Shader, unlike hardware-controlled instancing pipelines.
